description: Both branches of an `if=` / `else` chain mount the declaration inside its own render: unconditional on every path, E-DECL-RENDER-CYCLE-USE (#2139 review MED-2).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-component-self-mount-error ("a use of a declaration inside its own render ... that is unconditional on every path is a compile error at the use"); PA reading pa-ruled:S483-every-path-mounts (a chain ending in `else` every branch of which mounts it: every path mounts it)
rationale: §66.6.2 rule 2 (S483 r1): unconditional on every path holds for a use every branch of whose construct mounts the declaration.
